doctrines.note: Veterancy: Top Line (Overwhelming) recommended for Spartan kill / blob charge (65% minimum dmg, not affected by dmg reduction), or Bot Line for skirmish / higher dmg output on smaller unit packs. Hero pairing: Any (per Amya). Example build per OP: Yanyuedao Blue Slashing Doctrine, Unit Damage Doctrine V, Toughness Doctrine V (-33% DMG taken), Healing Punisher Doctrine (+20% DMG vs healing units), Epic Leadership Doctrine. Playstyle kit: despite CCi on first strike, always enter via Mounting Dread from flank/behind; charge 1 (Dread Unleashed) from optimal distance, release at max potential (cav strikes twice on impact, can cancel charge once second hit registers); often better to release ~70% charge if timing is right rather than wait for 100%; excels on smaller maps where lancers/specialized cav are hindered by terrain. Press 1 releases a first then second slash — X-move away after the first if needed, otherwise wait for the second then X-move (repress 1 to recharge ASAP). Press 2 (Rushing Blow) as a momentum builder on straight-line actions or as an escape (moves unit in its facing direction). Tips: learn full timing of the 1 — releasing it last moment allows re-triggering right after the double slash; when entering a blob facing pikes/stalwart/speed-bonus units, X-move side to side repeatedly to stop moving (minor dmg loss vs large dodge value). 'Don't put' is a literal X placeholder in the OP — not fabricated. Thread alt-romanization note: thread title is 'Yuanyuedao Enforcers / Yuandao / YYD' (Amya renamed the post 2024-12-30 but kept this title); tierlist and this record track the unit as 'Yanyuedao Cavalry' — same unit, alternate romanization, not a rename. Edit timestamp (2026-05-26) pre-dates the 2026-06-25 Chaos patch anchor; Yanyuedao Cavalry is NOT on the 13-unit Chaos shortlist, so staleAsOfPatch is not forced — noting pre-patch authorship per instructions only.

steps.text: Despite CCi on the first strike, always use Mounting Dread to enter the fight from flank or behind the enemy pack.
Charge your 1 (Dread Unleashed) from optimal distance and release at max potential for the highest damage. Cav strikes twice on impact; you can cancel the charge as soon as the second hit registers.
Don't overcommit always trying to charge to 100%. Often better to release at around 70% if the timing is right, than waiting for 100% and missing a good opportunity.
Excels on smaller maps where lancers or other specialized cav are hindered by environmental constraints — very versatile in such scenarios.
Pressing 1 releases a first slash then a second; X-move away after the first if needed, but in most cases wait for the second and X-move away (repress 1 to charge it again as soon as possible).
2 (Rushing Blow) should be used as a momentum builder on straight-line actions, or as an escape after the first few X-moves (each model moves in the direction it is facing).
